_: The suite that decides whether a mutation ships (`X-18`, and the canary in
Twenty tasks, not a hundred and six. A full round is seven hours and $50;
a gate that expensive is a gate that gets skipped, and a skipped gate is
worse than none because the loop still claims to have one.
Chosen by failure class rather than by score. A suite of the tasks a
harness already fails measures despair; a suite of the ones it already
passes measures nothing. These are the classes where this session's
measurements found real defects, plus a few that have never moved, which
are the control: a change that breaks one of those broke something
unrelated to what it was aiming at.
BEFORE THIS GATES ANYTHING, RUN IT A/A — the same binary, twice. 53 of 106
tasks moved between two runs of identical code, so the difference between
two runs of *different* code means nothing until the difference between two
runs of the same code is known. The A/A spread is the noise band, and it
goes in `noise_band` below, replacing the null that is there now.
A candidate promotes only when it clears the band. Until `noise_band` is a
number, this suite reports and decides nothing.
_noise_band_note: Measured 2026-08-10 by running this suite twice against the same binary
(perp.exe built 20:09 from da682bb). Nothing about the harness changed
The two runs differed by +4.34 points on the mean. Four of nineteen tasks
moved, and one of them moved by half: 008-image-recognize scored 0.50 then
1.00. That is what identical code looks like on this suite.
0.0577 is two standard errors of the mean difference (SE = 2.89 points).
A candidate must beat it to be called an improvement rather than weather.
This is an EXECUTION noise band only. The rubric is also non-deterministic
-- regrading the same 12 tasks twice gave 57.40% then 56.77% -- so a band
for a COMBINED score must be wider than this one. Do not reuse this number
Not compared: 003-browser, which produced no result in run 1 (its tunnel
hung and the process was killed). 19 of 20 tasks back this figure.
_snapshots: data_try6/canary/<harness>/run-N — written by tools/canary.py --calibrate, because the runner keys results by task id alone and a second run would otherwise overwrite the first

binding.why: T-38, T-39 and M-43 all landed here — 119 missing-argument and 50 unknown-tool refusals across one round. If the alias work regressed, it shows here first.

step-failure.why: The eight `perp: 1 steps failed` of the last round, which T-37 is meant to have fixed. Unverified until one of these rounds is clean.

fabrication.why: 045 scored 0.08 with the rubric note `fabricated file contents`. The scariest class for an unattended product and the one a grounding gate would target.

session-memory.why: 007 loses its round-two state. A product running long unattended sessions is this task, repeated for a week.

environment.why: 023 never located MOCK_FORM_URL — the harness knows things it does not tell the model. Same shape as M-43 one level up.

vision.why: 013 sits at 0.40 and is the only exercise of the image path (M-38).

control.why: Tasks that have never moved across six rounds. Not here to improve — here so that a change that breaks one is caught. A candidate that gains two points in the classes above and loses one here has not gained anything.

rules: Tag before every cycle. Rollback is the previous tag, never an apology.
Never run against a binary a live session is pinned to — L-40's fingerprint is what makes that checkable.
A candidate that improves the mean but breaks a control task is not promoted.
Report what was dropped. A suite that silently truncates reads as full coverage.
